scope: Amida brush coordinates, touch controls and walker path locals; six routines.
changes: PaintSquare now names brushX, brushY, colour, previous x neighbours, occupancy marks and the y grid offset; corrects the transposed parameter names and stale signature commentary.
CheckHurryButton and CheckEdgeBoost name the player slot, touch edge and touch coordinates.
ProbeRung names the starting x/y; StepWalker names the walker index, grid coordinates, current and next line marks, scaled progress and sound position.
StepWalkers distinguishes x/y pointers, direction storage, delay storage, completed walkers, goal matches and the pattern speed mode.

evidence.coordinates: HandlePen reads gTouchX/Y into Point.x/y; Mg_DrawLine dispatches PaintSquare(x,y,colour,size). The base PaintSquare uses its first coordinate as screen x. Amida stores ink at x * 0x158 + y + 0xc0.
evidence.walker_fields: include/dScMgAmida_c.h maps +0x4660/+0x4664 to walker x/y, +0x4680 to marks, +0x4684 to directions, +0x46b4 to done flags and +0x46b8 to delays. The direction switch explicitly increments/decrements the two coordinates.
evidence.progress: The progress500 local is (y + 0xd4) * 500 / (goalY + 0xd4); its name states the scale without assigning an unverified sound parameter meaning.
evidence.sound_position: func_020126e8 in src/engine/sound/Sound.cpp maps the fixed-point x argument into a clamped 0x1a..0x66 value passed to sound playback.
evidence.ownership_snapshot: build/scene-physics13-queue.json at bf99ec878a253a3437d8bd1bdb502ae49020609d: no nonterminal resource containing Amida, including class and old/new file spelling.
evidence.runtime_validation: No new emulator run: this pass follows existing fields, direct touch-coordinate dataflow and explicit arithmetic. No new dynamic behavior claim.
retained_constraints: All raw address expression trees, temporary lifetimes and optimisation pragmas retained.
StepWalkers retains unnamed literal-backed temporaries; this is a partial readability improvement.
Point special members, touch row declarations, helper membership and unk_53e4 unchanged.

verification.comparison_method: All allocated section metadata/bytes and named relocation records compare exactly, with no masking or canonicalization. Shared headers unchanged.

review_status: Producer checkpoint; independent source review and publication remain pending. Broader scene/physics goal remains active.
